queries.query: SELECT A.APPLNO, A.CPY_SELLER, A.CPY_BUYER, A.MP_APPLYMD, A.GRTNO, A.GRTTYPE, A.MP_APPLAMT, A.KCGF_AMT, A.STATUS, A.STATUS_YMDHMS, A.TRA_CD, B.CPY_NAME BUYNAME, C.CPY_NAME SELLNAME FROM [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.KIBO_GUARANTEE A INNER JOIN [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.COMPANY B ON B.CPY_ID = A.CPY_BUYER AND B.CPY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%') INNER JOIN [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.COMPANY C ON C.CPY_ID = A.CPY_SELLER AND B.CPY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%') WHERE (A.CPY_BUYER = ? OR A.CPY_SELLER = ?) AND A.MP_APPLYMD BETWEEN ? AND ? AND (CASE WHEN ? = '' THEN ? ELSE A.STATUS END) = ? ORDER BY A.MP_APPLYMD DESC

SELECT A.APPLNO , A.CPY_BUYER , A.CPY_SELLER , A.GRTTYPE , A.MP_APPLYMD , A.MP_APPLAMT , A.APPL_EXPIREYMD , A.TRA_CD , A.GRTNO , A.KCGF_AMT , A.ISSUEYMD , A.STATUS , A.STATUS_YMDHMS , A.FIRST_EXPIREYMD , A.FIRST_UNAMT , A.FIRST_UNAMT_YMDHMS , A.FIRST_UNAMT_OKYN , A.FIRST_UNAMT_OKYMDHMS , A.OFFLINE_AMT , A.OFFLINE_AMT_YMDHMS , A.OFFLINE_AMT_CLEARYN , A.OFFLINE_AMT_CLEARYMD , A.CHG_EXPIREYMD , A.CLEARYMD , A.DESCRIPTION , A.GRTNO01 , A.GRTNO02 , A.GRTNO03 , A.E221_SEQNO , A.E231_SEQNO , A.H221_SEQNO , A.H225H227_SEQNO , B.CPY_NAME , B.CPY_BUSINESS_NO , B.CPY_INCORPORATE_NO FROM [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.KIBO_GUARANTEE A WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.COMPANY B WITH (NOLOCK) ON B.CPY_ID = A.CPY_BUYER WHERE A.APPLNO = ?;

SELECT A.SEQNO, A.STARTYMD, A.ENDYMD, A.CONDITION, A.CHGUSER, A.CHGTIME FROM [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.INFO_GUARANTEE_CONDITION A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.CHGTYPE = '90' AND A.APPLNO = ? AND ISNULL(A.DELYESNO,'N') = 'N' ORDER BY A.SEQNO ASC;

SELECT A.SEQNO, A.CHGTYPE, CASE A.CHGTYPE WHEN '10' THEN '신규' WHEN '20' THEN '기한연장' WHEN '30' THEN '감액' WHEN '40' THEN '일부해지' WHEN '50' THEN '기한연장,감액' END AS CHGTYPE_NAME, A.STARTYMD, A.ENDYMD, A.AMT, A.CHGUSER, A.CHGTIME, A.CREUSER, A.CRETIME, A.CONDITION FROM [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.KIBO_GUARANTEE_CONDITION A WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE A.CHGTYPE NOT IN ('90') AND A.APPLNO = ? AND ISNULL(A.DELYESNO,'N') = 'N'
